notes: The page gives no included minutes, call allowances, or per-minute rates for the AI Employee add-ons or any plan. Voice AI and Conversation AI are marked "*Usage based charges apply" (lines 85-86, 110-112), but the AI usage rates are on a separate linked page that is not in this snapshot. Possible inconsistencies: (1) The annual prices look swapped or wrong. Founder ($497/mo) lists $2970/Year (line 57), and Unlimited ($297/mo) lists $4970/Year (line 71). (2) The $497 card is called "Founder" (line 55), but the FAQ calls it the "Pro Plan ($497/mo)" (line 176). (3) Line 117 mentions an "Agency Pro plan" that is not shown as a card. Sub-accounts: the FAQ says Starter includes 3 Sub-Accounts and Unlimited includes unlimited Sub-Accounts (line 175). Enterprise plan has no published price ("Speak with Our Enterprise Team", line 80). Billing is month-to-month with no long-term contract (line 167). Billing starts automatically when the trial ends, and usage fees may apply during the trial (line 188). Other add-ons are listed at lines 122-143 (e.g., HIPAA $297/month, Premium support $500/month, White label mobile app $497/month).
